text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Gim-senpai—! 
I finally get it. I see why you're so damn 
cool.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So I'm gonna stick to my guns too! 
To what *I* think makes someone cool...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Oho... And what of it?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm... your rival! 
And the coolest one here is gonna be ME!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... Heheheh...! 
Ahahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now that's the spirit, my wild, unaged 
vintage! 
Wager every shred of your soul! Come, and 
intoxicate me!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...! Yes, sir! I'm gonna blow you away!! 
Just you wait and see!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Driven by sheer exhilaration and 
conviction, the two push forward, with 
others trailing close behind. 
Their fiery passion feeds into one 
another, amplifying without end...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And finally, the day of Ligne Droite 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Executive Committee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—Attention, distinguished guests. The pair 
dancing will now commence. 
Will the participants of Group A please 
gather on the floor.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's finally starting! Where are 
Top-senpai and Gim-senpai...? Huh? 
They aren't here yet? Don't tell me things 
went wrong after all...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
No way in hell. Relax, they're definitely 
around somewhere. 
More importantly... don't you dare take 
your eyes off us.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Shall we begin our exquisite 
dream?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —Hah!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Aahh...! How marvelous...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
We managed to secure a good position. 
It will be easy to catch the judges' eyes 
here.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! It's all thanks to your great 
support, senpai!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. I am simply following your 
lead, Vodka-san.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Hehehe, nah, not at all! I'm really glad 
I asked you, Senpai. 
It felt just like this during our races 
too, didn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"No matter what kind of storm anyone kicks 
up, you always weather it with a cool 
head, Senpai. 
That's why... Haaah!"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoa! 
Ad-libbing, are we?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Adds to the realism, right? 
—Ah!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Found Orfe-senpai! So she did come. 
Ahaha, look at her grinning!"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"She really is... 
It's been so long since I last saw Orfe 
make a face like that..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Really? 
Well, with an older sister as cool as you, 
who wouldn't be thrilled!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Isn't it so "hot"!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: I see............ I see, I see...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Heh...! Was it really this simple all 
along?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "Huh? What's that?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"No, it's nothing. 
Vodka... thank you so much for inviting 
me."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Understood—their—capabilities— 
However—I will not concede."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Target in sight. 
Securing—Best Date."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Let us go—follow—my lead.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Ooooh! What an elegant escort...! 
Haaah~~! So dreamy...!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Once decided—see it through. 
That is the—mindset—for victory."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Tonight's victors—are us.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
"—Everyone's amaaaazing! So ridiculously 
cool~~♡ 
Wait, isn't this insane? Far from lacking 
favorites, the competition is on fire!"

text_block_list.name: Mean-Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Not really... It's nothing special...! 
That was totally... amateurish anyway...!"

text_block_list.name: Followers
text_block_list.text:
"Ah... hahaha... you think so~~? 
It might be~ a bit better than I 
expected...?"

text_block_list.name: Mean-Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, where'd that weirdo duo go? 
D-Did they chicken out and run away, or 
something...?"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Kukukuk! Don't be ridiculous. 
The stars of tonight's show are right 
here—"
